remarks: Gorgeous 6 acre private property available Stamford,CT/Pound Ridge,NY! A unique opportunity to build on one of the last available lots in N. Stamford’s most prestigious, upscale and highly sought after established neighborhoods, surrounded by multi-million dollar estates. The exquisite and private 6 acre property spans the Pound Ridge NY and Stamford CT borders, very near to the Greenwich line. South Lake Drive is a quiet cul-de-sac, abutting 700+ acre Bargh Reservoir, and nearby Mianus River Gorge Preserve. Build your custom dream home in either Stamford,CT or Pound Ridge,NY. Obtain a subdivision for a possible large lot; consider a donation of surplus land to one of the charitable land preservation groups, possible substantial income tax deduction, as well as lower property taxes. Perfect for a year round home or a phenomenal weekend getaway retreat, a nature lover's dream. Only minutes from several premier public and private golf courses, Explore Stamford's waterfront Harbor Point, gorgeous beaches and all that downtown Stamford has to offer. Visit nearby New Canaan, Greenwich, Norwalk, Westport, Scott’s Corners, and Bedford for great shopping, restaurants, parks, hiking, theater, and entertainment! Conveniently located to Merritt Prky & I-684, Metro North & airport. Less than an hour from NYC. Buyer to do all due diligence. Also offered as a To-Be-Built SF home 5BR 3.5BA, 5054 SF, ask about details. Owner has RE license.
